metaTitle: How to delete behind cursor in Pages on Mac
description: Learn how to delete behind cursor in Pages on Mac using standard keys and advanced shortcuts. Master text editing with these simple step by step instructions.
intro: To delete text behind the cursor in Pages on a Mac, simply press the Delete key on your keyboard. This standard action removes the character immediately to the left of your current insertion point.
tldr: Press Delete to remove the character behind the cursor.
Use fn + Delete to remove the character in front of the cursor.
Hold Option + Delete to remove entire words behind the cursor.
Use Command + Delete to clear text to the start of a line.
Use Command + Z immediately if you delete something by accident.

blocks.text: Understanding the Delete key on Mac

The Mac keyboard layout differs from traditional PC keyboards. On a standard Mac, the key labeled Delete functions as a backspace key. It removes the character to the left of the cursor. This is the primary way to edit your text. If you are new to the Mac ecosystem, this behavior might feel different than what you expect. Most Windows keyboards feature a dedicated Backspace and a separate Delete key. Apple chooses to keep the layout compact. This requires using modifier keys to access secondary deletion functions. You will find that mastering these few key combinations makes your writing much faster.
How to delete characters and words

Beyond the basic delete, you have options for bulk removal. These shortcuts help you clean up long sentences or paragraphs without needing to click and drag your mouse. When you need to remove a full word, hold the Option key while pressing Delete. This removes the entire word behind the cursor. It stops at punctuation marks and spaces. If you need to remove text to the beginning of a line, hold the Command key and press Delete. This is useful when you want to restart a sentence or clear a header. Using these shortcuts prevents repetitive clicking.

Sometimes you need to remove text to the right of your cursor. Since there is no dedicated forward delete key on most Mac laptops, you use the function key. Hold the fn key and press Delete. This action deletes the character in front of your cursor. This is a common requirement when you are editing existing documents or fixing typos. If you use an external Apple keyboard with a numeric keypad, you might find a dedicated Forward Delete key. On standard laptop keyboards, the fn key combination is the standard method.

blocks.caption: Keyboard shortcuts for text deletion in Pages for Mac.

blocks.text: Users occasionally report that their keyboard feels stuck. If text disappears rapidly, check for physical debris under your keys. Sometimes, software settings cause unexpected behavior. Go to System Settings and check your Text Input settings. If the autocorrect feature is aggressive, it might replace or remove text as you type. Disable automatic spelling correction to test if the issue persists. If you accidentally delete a large block of text, use the undo command immediately. Press Command + Z to restore your work. This is your best friend when editing complex documents.

Pages offers two main document modes. Word Processing mode and Page Layout mode. Deleting pages works differently in each. In Word Processing mode, you cannot simply delete a page thumbnail. You must place your cursor at the end of the content. Press the Delete key repeatedly until the page disappears. In Page Layout mode, you can right-click a thumbnail in the sidebar. This allows you to delete the entire page directly. Understanding which mode you are in saves a lot of time.

faq.question: Why does my Delete key behave like a backspace?
faq.answer: This is standard behavior for Mac keyboards. The key labeled Delete performs a backspace function, removing the character to the left of the cursor.

faq.question: How do I delete text to the right of the cursor?
faq.answer: Hold the fn key and press Delete to perform a forward delete on standard Mac laptop keyboards.

faq.question: Can I customize these keyboard shortcuts?
faq.answer: Yes, you can modify keyboard shortcuts in macOS System Settings. Navigate to Keyboard and select Keyboard Shortcuts to assign your own keys.

task: Delete text behind the cursor in Apple Pages.
appliesTo: Apple Pages 15.4 on macOS 15.6 or later.

steps.name: Position the cursor
steps.text: Click in your document to place the blinking insertion point immediately after the text you wish to delete.

steps.name: Press Delete
steps.text: Press the Delete key on your keyboard once for each character you want to remove to the left of the cursor.

steps.name: Delete entire words
steps.text: Hold the Option key and press Delete to remove the entire word to the left of the cursor at once.

troubleshooting.fix: Check for stuck keys or disable automatic text replacement in System Settings.
Ensure you are in Word Processing mode and delete all hidden characters until the page is removed.
